note: CA-6: a Kotlin receiver typed by a function parameter (`store: ItemStore`), a typed `val log: AuditLog` or a constructor-initialised `val log = AuditLog()` binds the method on that type through LA.35a's local_types. ItemStore and AuditLog both declare write(), so no repo-unique name can bind it. `val log = store` has no declared or constructed type: it is a local of unknown type and binds nothing.

forbid.note: an untyped alias is a local of unknown type
